title: TrackSpace DSA Core 75
summary: A curated 75-problem foundational DSA curriculum organized across 15 core patterns, covering essential coding interview problem types.
description: TrackSpace DSA Core 75 is a focused, high-yield Data Structures and Algorithms curriculum designed to master core coding interview patterns. Spanning 75 essential problems across 15 distinct patterns—including Arrays & Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Linked Lists, Binary Search, Trees, Dynamic Programming, Backtracking, Graphs, and Greedy algorithms—this track emphasizes pattern recognition, optimal complexity, and systematic spaced repetition.
